lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hello Carmen, it's Jorge. Do you have a few minutes for our call?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hey, yeah, I was waiting for your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Great. So today I'd like to hear how the band exercises went, check how you're feeling, and pick a goal for next week. Anything you want to add?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How's your body feeling this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Not great. The hot flashes are back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Did you hit your goal this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I did it! 5 out of 5 days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: That's real progress.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're open to it. You just want it to fit your real life.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I need to get my sugar down.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A lot of people do the band exercises while they watch TV. It makes it feel like less of a chore.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I know I can do it, I did it before.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Whatever you pick is fine with me. It's your plan.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Part of you is already moving, and you want to keep that going.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You need to do the exercises every day or you'll lose muscle.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Easy for you to say.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Part of you wants this, and part of you is just worn out.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If you don't do this, your health is going to suffer.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're still figuring out what works.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You figured that out on your own.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I can probably manage three days. I wrote it on the calendar.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You have to make this a priority.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're really honest with yourself, and that helps.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So, I need this for my head too, not just my body. My neighbor started doing it with me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You want to be around and be well for the people you love.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll set an alarm on my phone. It's just me and my husband now, so it's easier.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Would it be okay if I shared something that's helped other people?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A lot of people do the band exercises while they watch TV. It makes it feel like less of a chore.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What feels doable for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Maybe do the band exercises 5 times?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If getting started gets in the way again, what's your backup plan?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll go to the mall instead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So, to sum up: getting started made this week harder, you still got 5 days in, and your plan is to do the band exercises 5 times. Sound right?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That's it exactly.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Tuesday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Take care, Carmen. You're doing great.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, talk soon.

tags.note: Reflects openness not clearly voiced by participant yet
Warning about muscle loss without permission

flags.reason: Warns of muscle loss and mandates daily exercise without permission; participant pushed back on line 21.
Health-threat warning ('your health is going to suffer') increases resistance; not MI-consistent.
'You have to make this a priority' imposes a directive right after participant reported a mixed week.
Repeats the TV-exercise tip verbatim after participant did not engage with it the first time.

score.summary: Carmen reported 5 of 5 exercise days and the coach affirmed that progress and set a clear, self-chosen goal with a barrier plan and summary. However, the coach repeatedly persuaded with warnings and directives (lines 20, 25, 35) and repeated a tip verbatim (line 43), which undercut the autonomy the coach otherwise offered.
strengths: Line 10 and line 32: affirmed real progress and her self-directed problem solving.
Line 41: asked permission before sharing a suggestion.
Line 50: open backup-plan question helped Carmen plan for barriers.
Line 52: concise summary confirmed the plan with Carmen.
coaching_tips: Replace the warnings in line 20 and line 25 with an open question about what Carmen thinks the exercise is worth to her.
Line 35 ('You have to make this a priority') pushed against her 'Maybe' in line 47; try a reflection of the ambivalence instead.
Do not repeat the TV tip in line 43; if it was unwelcome, ask what might make exercise easier.
Use more complex reflections on her change talk, such as line 38 ('need this for my head') and line 40 (husband makes it easier).
